audit: V83 shared finite events through stochastic DIR
image_change: none; exact second-order pre-render gate only

shared_event_model.construction: For matched same-population/same-size-class sites, alpha selects one common U(0,1); 1-alpha selects independent uniforms. Extra sites in a record remain independent.
shared_event_model.marginals: exact finite Bernoulli/binomial for every record

rms_gate.authority: digitized Kodak processed-stock diffuse RMS graph
rms_gate.note: Five percent is an explicit engineering gate, not a tolerance published by Kodak; the source graph itself is visually digitized.

monte_carlo_verification.purpose: Verification only: direct finite multinomial/binomial samples catch frequency-transfer or matrix-indexing mistakes; the analytic integral remains the deterministic audit authority.

decision: The shared-event family passes the pre-render marginal-RMS gate at every tested alpha/exposure endpoint. It may proceed only to an explicitly labelled uncertainty render; no alpha is identified as 5279.
evidence_boundary: Public 5279 material publishes marginal processed-record RMS, not cross-record covariance, native NPS, physical site registration or a joint three-record event law. Passing this audit proves internal compatibility only; it does not measure a 5279 alpha.
